Question: The number \(695\) is to be written with a factorial base of numeration, that is, \[ \begin{aligned} 695={}&a_1+a_2\cdot2!+a_3\cdot3!\\ &+\cdots+a_n\cdot n!, \end{aligned} \] where \(a_1,\) \(a_2,\) \(a_3,\) \(\ldots,\) \(a_n\) are integers such that \(0\le a_k\le k,\) and \(n!\) means \(n(n-1)(n-2)\cdots2\cdot1.\) Find \(a_4.\)
